integrity: Claim, exact proof, verification instructions and bounded literature comparison are supplied; finite checker corroborates but does not replace the universal analytic argument. No external mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Existence of skew conference matrices is assumed, not proved for every order.
No classification of five-point switching orbits or spectra of larger subsets.
Potential historical equivalences under the terminology of conference principal minors or five erasures are not completely excluded.
title: Five-column spectral dichotomy and exact multiplicities for skew-conference tight frames
